principles: END GOAL (CLAUDE.md execution expectation): floor = ReAct parity for any task via walk + tool-enabled fallback, every step traced; ceiling = learned-pathway reuse; middle = first/last-mile adaptation over an existing pathway; full re-derivation on near-miss means nothing was learned
CLAUDE.md: reach ~90% on arbitrary useful goals regardless of priors is mechanism correctness, not a metric; reach failures are information-availability failures; high reach on trivial goals is gamed
CLAUDE.md operator role: autonomy success = substrate-authored commit on remote working branch with no operator hands; operator becomes structurally non-load-bearing (S1->S2->S3)
Foundation Core Premise: progressively convert workflow stages into routable programmatic components; convergence = recall reliably succeeds without new structure for known goal classes
Law 1 (CLAUDE.md): everything behavioral is a shape; env/config are bootstrap-only
Law 2: behaviors are activities (selectable, graded, retirable)
Law 3 / foundation Reuse Before Mint: find an existing producer before minting; a wrong mint is negative value; enforced at mint chokepoint and selection
Law 4: activities are earned by doing (ribosome extraction), not declared
Law 5: pace is rhythm impulses; boredom = condition-driven selection
Law 6: don't rob self-maintenance; every bug class -> patch instance, detector for class, generator goal
Law 7: measure by gap triple (close rate, latency, durability - no reappearance in a different hat); learned disposition
Law 8: information at the right time - confabulation is information starvation
Law 9: docs are timeless expectations; alignment is substrate work (docs-align loop)
Law 10: memory belongs to the system (memoryNote authoritative)
Law 11: location independence with data locality
Law 12: causal discipline - decision-time counterfactuals, change one thing
Law 13: humans are resolvers, not preprocessors
Foundation Pointer-as-Shape: the pointer is the shape; all resolution and learning keyed on it
Foundation Minimum Self-Stable Set: impulse, pointer, resolver, vessel (hypothesis under test); each implicit side channel is evidence
Foundation data-plane invariant: every vessel-to-vessel data exchange is a typed impulse to a discovery-advertised resolve_endpoint; control-plane exempt (also IMPULSE_CONFORMANCE_LEDGER)

Foundation Design Principles 1-8: impulses universal; activities constrain search; resolvers live where data lives; metadata first; record everything; learn from traces; reserve improvisation (recorded); LLMs are tools not controllers
Foundation Backend's Role: activity-api is trace store + pattern learner, not a universal resolver
Foundation Reachable subgraph: advertised is a claim, demonstrated is a fact; coverage must separate never-attempted / never-succeeded / succeeded-then-stopped
Foundation Topology Discovery step 5: reward attaches to reaching the goal, not exiting cleanly
Foundation F-39 residue: learning-signal paths need instrumentation that makes their absence observable
Foundation thompson_posterior repair: a shape returning a plausible-but-different value is worse than no shape
Foundation Known Gaps: keep closed entries as reusable repair patterns
SUBSTRATE_AS_DYNAMICS header: common scale on both sides; a described detector is not a running one; a measurement is not a governor until something acts on it; check freshness not presence

SUBSTRATE_AS_DEC 4.4 / DYNAMICS 3: master inequality lambda1(L(t)) >~ rho_grow - drafting or vessel-spawning without raising throughput is self-defeating; livelock = looks busy, not learning (conjecture)
SUBSTRATE_AS_DEC 2: resolvers-where-data-lives = sparsity of L; orthogonality is the moat = block-diagonal metric over shape x signature x tier x scope
SUBSTRATE_AS_FLEET 3 / NETWORK 5: share evidence, not weights; fold signed foreign evidence into local posterior under conservative prior; ephemeral never crosses
FLEET 0 / foundation: nothing above discovery sees a substrate
NETWORK 6: converge by default (CRDT/gossip), agree only where forced
RESOLVER_TRACKING: resolver tier = binned directional certainty; LLM->deterministic distillation is additive, LLM never removed
RUNTIME_ACTIVITY_TRACING: bound retention first, install instruments second; confirm an instrument by its effect; a wrapper row must never absorb a failure belonging to what it wrapped
SHAPE_ACTION_EVIDENCE header: docs hold expectations, not readings; numbers in docs get fed to the drafter as current truth
sequences/04: failure is graded not merely detected (canonical taxonomy); a staged change is never graded as done
sequences/05: reactive behaviour is an activity (subscription block), never a process-start callback

HUMAN_PARTICIPATION / EXPLICABILITY: receipt != consumption != learning, each transition needs a linked record; unanswered question is not agreement; a variant that hides evidence to reduce objections is a regression
